rationale: Lead with measured feedforward so feedback only trims residual. E4 holds 0.571 at u=0.33, E5 holds 0.527 at u=0.27, E7 holds 0.483 flat at u=0.26, E6 holds 0.466 at u=0.25: linear fit y_ss=0.15+1.32*u gives u*=0.265 for y=0.5, so ff=(target-0.15)/1.32. Tau ~120-180s (E2 63% decay ~176s, small steps settle 140-200s), so filter tau 22s suppresses +/-0.03 noise/outliers without adding lag, and PI Kp=1.0 Ki=0.007 gives closed-loop (1+K*Kp)=2.32, zeta~0.99 near-critical, P-alone offset for 0.02 ff error only 0.014 so band is held even before integral finishes. Integral clamped to +/-0.15 corrects worst plausible ff error 0.06-0.07 (ambient 0.10-0.20, K 1.2-1.4) without windup; conditional freeze on saturation plus output cap 0.70 keeps far from 0.85 soft / 0.9 hard limits and saves energy.

extra.machine_card: Heater, positive gain: more power = hotter. Gain K~1.26-1.40, use 1.32: y_ss ~0.15+1.32*u. Ambient/self-drain to ~0.15 at u=0 (E2 480s to 0.147, slope 0). No dead zone: 0.25/0.26/0.27/0.3/0.33/0.4 all heat in order. Speed: slow first-order tau ~120-180s, still rising after 280-300s at 0.3/0.4, small steps settle in 140-200s. To hold 0.5 need u*~0.26-0.27 (0.26 holds 0.483 in-band flat, 0.27 holds 0.527 just above, 0.25 holds 0.466 just below, 0.33 holds 0.571). Noise large: +/-0.02-0.03 scatter plus 0.04-0.08 dips, only >0.05 moves over 100s are dynamics. Stay below 0.85, cutoff at 0.9 forces u=0.
extra.predicted_behavior: From cold 0.15: u saturates ~0.6-0.65, y reaches lower band 0.475 in ~110-150s, enters 0.475-0.525 by ~180-250s with overshoot <0.015, centered to 0.50 +/-0.01 after ~400-600s. From above 0.57: u drops to ~0.15-0.20, decays into band in ~100-150s. Steady state: u~0.26-0.28, y~0.50, P jitter +/-0.015, u jitter +/-0.02. No oscillation, no cutoff violation, energy near minimum (steady u^2 ~0.07).
